# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Age:** School-aged child  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is considered fat for her age. She has a malicious smile and is known to look scouted or blushing when caught cheating. She also wears artificial flowers on her hats like other local girls.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P7](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0007), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Josie Pye is known as a cheat and possesses a malicious, sulky, and uncharitable nature. She enjoys gloating over others and triumphing in dares, often displaying an airy unconcern. She is also quick to make snide or spiteful remarks about her schoolmates.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)_

- Malicious  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047)</sub>

## Abilities

- Walking board fences with skill and balance  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## History

Josie Pye attended Avonlea school, where she competed with her classmates, including Anne Shirley. During one lesson, she cheated by peeking in her book, which was observed by Anne, though the teacher failed to notice. Later, when Anne was punished by standing at the blackboard, Josie gave her malicious smiles. At Diana Barry's party, Josie successfully walked a narrow board fence after being dared by Anne. To outdo Josie, Anne attempted to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, which resulted in Anne falling and breaking her ankle. Following Anne's accident, Josie visited her during her recovery, though Anne noted she lacked imagination. Josie joined the school story club, but hated the recitations and field afternoons. She became sulky when she was denied the role of Fairy Queen in the Christmas concert, claiming a red-haired fairy was ridiculous. After the concert, she fell out with Julia Bell after repeating a critical comment to Bessie Wright.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)_
